title: Representative-guitar useful-lock evaluator criteria
frozen_before: any trace generation, adapter invocation or measurement

definitions.event_clock: device time of the audio a beat/tempo report is about; a backend-reported sub-block device time when causal, else the block start
definitions.horizon_clock: device time at which the backend returned the evidence (block end); causal availability
definitions.receipt_clock: wall-clock time at which the evaluator published/received the evidence; block-resolution audio receipt is the last processed block end and is never mixed with event or horizon
definitions.lock_run: consecutive predicted beats, each within beat_tolerance_seconds of a distinct forward-advancing ground-truth beat, each accompanied by a phase-valid tempo within bpm_agreement_fraction of the local ground-truth BPM
definitions.lock_acquisition_bars: beat position of the first beat of the first lock run (event clock) divided by meter.beats_per_bar; mirrors EVAL-002/TRACK-004 (no lock-run semantics are redefined)
definitions.useful_lock: a lock_run of exactly lock_run_bars acquired within acquisition_window_bars AND correct BPM AND usable phase; a Locked label alone is not sufficient

gate.population: recordings classified real, marked representative, with a human/licensed annotation, a steady 4/4 meter, at least min_annotated_beats annotated beats, a valid trace from every required backend, and matching audio sha256/rate
gate.rule: useful_lock fraction over the gate population >= min_gate_fraction
fail_closed: no representative real annotated steady recording: GATE FAIL, empty population is never a pass
any gate recording lacks a trace or annotation: GATE FAIL
any trace/annotation/audio identity mismatch or malformed: GATE FAIL
any NaN/Infinity or non-monotonic clock: GATE FAIL
synthetic or derived recordings never count toward the gate

classification_rules.real: an external human performance; requires human annotation and explicit ownership/license; cannot be fabricated
classification_rules.synthetic: generated audio (for example the committed testdata/rhythm corpus); diagnostic only, never a G3 gate recording
classification_rules.derived: a transform of another recording or a trace-level candidate; requires parent identity; never a G3 gate recording
classification_rules.synthetic_mislabelled_real: classification real without human-sourced annotation or with a generated provenance marker is invalid and fails closed

trace_timing_rules: event_seconds <= horizon_seconds for every beat and tempo sample that reports a horizon
receipt.audio_seconds >= max(horizon) when receipt is measured
receipt is block-resolution only; no sub-block or measured device latency claim
missing timing is explicit null with a measured=false flag, never a fabricated zero

evidence_policy.wav_commit: private real recordings are never committed; the import manifest stores path + sha256 + rate + duration and supports non-repo locations
evidence_policy.preserve: existing evidence and corpora are read-only; this tool writes only new paths under tools/guitar-lock-eval and docs/research/guitar-lock-eval
evidence_policy.diagnostic_candidate: any tuning (for example a beat-interval-derived tempo) is a derived trace-level candidate scored beside the real backends; it is never a production promotion and performs no src/ change
